_comment: Reference template only. To deploy manually via the AWS Console or CLI, replace REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_REGION with your monitoring account region, and replace REPLACE_WITH_WARNING_ALARM_ARN / REPLACE_WITH_CRITICAL_ALARM_ARN with the WarningAlarmArn and CriticalAlarmArn outputs from the monitoring-account CloudFormation stack. When deployed via CloudFormation (monitoring-account.yaml), substitution is automatic.

# Central EC2 disk monitoring
Metrics are shared from member accounts through CloudWatch cross-account observability. Warning: 80%. Critical: 90%.

properties.title: Highest disk utilization across linked source accounts

metrics.expression: SELECT MAX(disk_used_percent) FROM SCHEMA(CWAgent, InstanceId, path, fstype) GROUP BY AWS.AccountId, InstanceId, path
metrics.label: Disk utilization
